Classic Cotton Tee

What is a 220 gsm tee?

A 220 gsm t-shirt uses fabric that weighs 220 grams per square metre, which makes it noticeably thicker and more opaque than a standard 150–180 gsm tee. It holds its shape after washing and drapes with more structure, so it works well as a stand-alone layer in cooler weather and under an open overshirt.

Fabric and fit

The fabric is 100% combed ring-spun cotton, garment dyed and pre-shrunk. The fit is relaxed through the chest with slightly dropped shoulders. If you prefer a closer fit, size down once. Every measurement is listed in the size chart below, taken flat across the chest and from the high point of the shoulder to the hem, so you can compare against a shirt you already own and like.

Care

Wash cold inside out with similar colours, and tumble dry low or hang dry. Avoid bleach. Iron on medium heat if needed. Garment-dyed cotton fades gently over time, which is part of the look; washing cold slows that down considerably.
